title: Implement the Admin Service and Login Handlers.
objective:
Implement the Admin Service and Login Handlers.
  
  Requirements:
  1. Create app/services/admin_service.py to handle admin session creation and validation using AdminSession and AdminToken models.
  2. The service should use AppContext for database sessions.
  3. Create app/handlers/admin/auth.py to handle the /admin_login <token> command.
  4. Use the AdminToken model to verify the provided token (hash it first).
  5. Upon successful login, create an AdminSession in the database.
  6. Register the new admin router in app/handlers/__init__.py and app/handlers/admin/__init__.py.
  7. Keep access_level as a simple number for now.
  
  Files to create/edit:
  - app/services/__init__.py
  - app/services/admin_service.py
  - app/handlers/admin/auth.py
  - app/handlers/admin/__init__.py
  - app/handlers/__init__.py
